text:
michael: Planning frontend deploy for Dashboard v2.7.1 at 2026-05-21 16:00 UTC. Goal: minimal downtime. Need CDN invalidation for changed assets + smoke checks. Canary at T+0, rollback ready. Window 16:00-16:15. :rocket:
anya: Which assets changed? full site or just hashed static files?
michael: Only hashed bundles and a couple fonts under /static/dashboard/. Prefer path-based purge for speed. Command I used in staging:
```
curl -X POST https://cdn-api.company/purge \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CDN_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"paths":["/static/dashboard/*.js","/static/dashboard/*.css"]}'
```
leo: I'll take smoke. Smoke checklist: login, dashboard load (first paint <1s), widgets populate, settings save, search, embeddings endpoint returns 200. I'll run from my laptop and report.
kat: Quick FYI — hit 404 for fonts in staging (/static/dashboard/fonts/). Might need fonts in purge too.
michael: Good catch, include fonts path. Updated purge payload: add "/static/dashboard/fonts/*". Also plan: wait ~5m after purge for edge propagation then start canary.
anya: I'll update the runbook with the checklist and add the rollback steps.
leo: Oncall here. Timeline: 16:00 push canary (10% traffic), 16:05 smoke complete, 16:07 if green promote to 100% else rollback by 16:10.
michael: Rollback command (k8s):
```
kubectl -n frontend set image deploy/dashboard dashboard=registry.company.com/dashboard:v2.7.0 && kubectl rollout status deploy/dashboard
```
michael: If rollback needed, also re-run CDN purge for v2.7.0 assets to ensure cache consistency.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for dashboard:v2.7.1 — 10% traffic -> 16:00:12 UTC
leo: Starting smoke now. Login ok. First paint 920ms. Widget feed ok. Search returns results. :thumbsup: 
kat: I still see one font 404 on a specific edge (edge-us-east-2). I'm invalidating fonts edge-wide now.
michael: Thanks. If fonts persist after 5m, we'll rollback. Otherwise promoting in 2m.
leo: Promoting to 100% now.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete — dashboard:v2.7.1 -> 100% traffic
leo: Post-promote verification done. All smoke checks pass. Closing window. Great job. :tada:
